 now 14.40 EDT United’s players wander over to apologise to whatever flimsy remnant of the travelling support isn’t already drowning their sorrows in a nearby hostelry.
 Share 2m ago 14.39 EDT Final score: Como 4-1 Manchester United
 90+4 mins: Say what you like about this United performance, they completely dominated that period of stoppage time, and won it 1-0!
 Share Updated at  14.39 EDT 5m ago 14.36 EDT GOAL! Como 4-1 Manchester United (Zirkzee, 90+1 mins)
 United do have their consolation! Amad chips the pass into the box, Zirkzee escapes from his marker and brings it down beautifully, leaving himself with a pretty easy finish which he calmly completes.
 Share 6m ago 14.34 EDT 90+1 mins: There’ll be three minutes of stoppage time, or thereabouts.
 Share 7m ago 14.33 EDT 89 mins: … Not like that they can’t. Lacey takes the corner, and three defenders line up at the near post to boot it clear, which one of them emphatically does.
 Share 8m ago 14.32 EDT 89 mins: Amad wins United a corner. Could they end the night with a consolation?
 Share 10m ago 14.31 EDT 87 mins: Lacey swiftly earns himself a booking. “The Guardian called for jeopardy in this competition. I think Man Utd have found it for you,” writes Ian Copestake. Their remaining Champions League fixtures: Roma (h), Sporting (a), Leipzig (h), Bayern Munich (h), Villarreal (a).
 Share 11m ago 14.29 EDT 86 mins: Another United substitution, Lacey replacing Mbeumo.
 Share 12m ago 14.28 EDT 84 mins: Kempf is booked, I think less for bringing down Amad than for being grumpy with the referee for giving the free-kick.
 Share 14m ago 14.27 EDT 82 mins: The last time Manchester United lost by four goals in Europe was more than 30 years ago, against a team that included Stoichkov, Romario and some chap called Guardiola.
 2 November 1994: Manchester United are thrashed in Barcelona Read more Share 16m ago 14.24 EDT 80 mins: Como bring on Smolcic, Ricci and Dossena, and take off Couto, Paz and Perrone.
 Share 17m ago 14.24 EDT 79 mins: Amass comes on for De Ligt, whose return from injury is the silver lining to tonight’s miserable, charcoal-grey cloud for United.
 Share 18m ago 14.22 EDT 78 mins: Como are hunting for a fifth, but Paz shoots too close to Lammens.
 Share 19m ago 14.22 EDT GOAL! Como 4-0 Ohno (Ramon, 76 mins)
 That is delicious. Ramon, the centre-back, spots Maguire creeping out of position and reckons he can get into that empty space before anyone notices. And turns out he was right. Kaiki Bruno sees him sprinting into an empty penalty area and sends in a perfect, precise cross, and Ramon hammers his header home from six yards!
 View image in fullscreen Jacobo Ramon heads home to give Como a fourth goal. Photograph: Mattia Ozbot/Uefa/Getty Images View image in fullscreen Ramon celebrates. Photograph: Claudia Greco/Reuters Share Updated at  14.27 EDT 22m ago 14.18 EDT 73 mins: Zirkzee has brought a bit of extra pace and energy to the United team, if not any improvement in control. “Well, although it is quite funny (as a Liverpool fan) to watch a club swing from one manager to another chasing a dominance they once had (ahem), how much of the current malaise can be blamed on trying to keep up with the noisy neighbours across the city?” wonders Andy Flintoff (not that one). “Feeling that they have to do that has probably accelerated that swing and made the lurches more extreme.” I suppose it can’t have helped, though it seemed to have more of a positive effect on some other teams (if not their bank balances).
 Share 27m ago 14.14 EDT 69 mins: Kaiki Bruno and his exemplary caterpillar moustache comes on for Da Cunha.
 Share Updated at  14.14 EDT 28m ago 14.13 EDT 67 mins: Bruno Fernandes is taken off, which feels a bit like an admission of defeat. Zirkzee replaces him.
 Share 30m ago 14.10 EDT 66 mins: Amad shoots from 22 yards or so. The ball flies over Butez’s head and was probably also going over the bar but the keeper made sure.
 Share 32m ago 14.09 EDT 64 mins: Como bring Caqueret on for Baturina. United have been playing for the last five minutes or so with Mazraoui on the right and Dalot on the left.
 Share 34m ago 14.07 EDT 62 mins: Amad has been bright since he came on at half-time. He’s at the heart of a United attack but it ends with a blind cross, and a clearance. “Watching United at the moment, they look like a side completely in limbo, unable to move on,” writes Paul Flint. “The players surely know that Carrick is going sooner rather than later, and must be wondering about their futures. It doesn’t encourage in-game focus, however much they may be paid.”
 Share 36m ago 14.05 EDT 60 mins: Tielemans has a shot from the edge of the area, but it’s more of an apology than a challenge and Butez picks it up.
 Share 37m ago 14.03 EDT 59 mins: Paz tries another curler, this one from the edge of the D, but this one floats too close to Lammens.
 Share 38m ago 14.02 EDT GOAL! Como 3-0 Manchester United (Paz, 57 mins)
 Baleba hits a pass into Nico Paz’s shins just inside the United half and the ball runs beautifully into the Argentinian’s path, so he heads off, runs into the area, draws the keeper, and slides the ball across goal and in at the far post!
 View image in fullscreen Another smart finish from Nico Paz gives him his second goal of the night, and Como’s third. Photograph: Claudia Greco/Reuters View image in fullscreen Joy for Paz and the Como fans … Photograph: Alessandro Garofalo/Reuters View image in fullscreen Despair for Bruno Fernandes and his Manchester United teammates … Photograph: Alessandro Garofalo/Reuters View image in fullscreen And their manager Michael Carrick. Photograph: Kieran McManus/Shutterstock Share Updated at  14.15 EDT 40m ago 14.01 EDT 56 mins: An actually good United move ends with Mount flicking the ball towards Bruno Fernandes, but it’s intercepted.
 Share 42m ago 13.59 EDT 55 mins: Como should have had a third! Paz passes to Da Cunha, who shifts onto his left foot to open up a great shooting chance, 12 yards out, but then cuts across the ball rather than curling it with his instep, and it skews the wrong side of the post!
 Share 43m ago 13.58 EDT 54 mins: “I know watching United’s downfall has been fun for rival fans, I totally get that and don’t blame them for relishing it,” writes Lee Woolsey. “And I know this gets said a lot by fans about their team when they’re playing badly, but I’m sorry: this United team just look like they don’t care. They were a goal down after two minutes and the remaining 43 were an exercise in collective shoulder shrugging by a team of mercenaries assembled by a parasitic reign of witches. People DIED for this club. These players are a risible disgrace.” It’s very easy to blame the players, though. They aren’t well coached. They haven’t been well recruited. It’s the whole edifice.
 Share 44m ago 13.56 EDT 52 mins: “Not having a screen to watch this on, and just going on your mbm, I don’t think that Mount hasn’t been mentioned, is he doing as little as suggested?” wonders Martin Lancon. In brief, yes. United’s midfield hasn’t done very much. There were a couple of moments in the first half when Mount exchanged passes with Bruno Fernandes and the pair briefly looked pretty classy, but they haven’t achieved anything creatively. And as I type that Mount has a rubbish shot from 30 yards.
 Share 46m ago 13.55 EDT 50 mins: That’s just so easy. Paz carries the ball forwards, Douvikas runs into a massive space between De Ligt, who just didn’t see the run coming, and Maguire – the Dutchman stumbles at a crucial moment, but he was already out of the race – and finishes superbly!
 View image in fullscreen Tasos Douvikas (number 9) doubles Como’s lead with a smart finish. Photograph: Marco Luzzani/Getty Images View image in fullscreen Douvikas (third left) celebrates with his Como teammates. Photograph: Mattia Ozbot/Uefa/Getty Images View image in fullscreen Then heads back to his own half beside dejectected Manchester United players. Photograph: Marco Luzzani/Getty Images Share Updated at  14.06 EDT 47m ago 13.53 EDT GOAL! Como 2-0 Manchester United (Douvikas, 49 mins)
 A brighter restart for United, but in just over three minutes they’re two down!
 Share 51m ago 13.50 EDT 46 mins: Peeeeep! The game has restarted, and United have made a double halftimely substitution, Matheus Cunha and Andrey Santos going off, Diallo and Baleba coming on.
 Share 1h ago 13.43 EDT Just one goal, and that from a wonderful shot from outside the area, does not really reflect what has not been a tightly-contested game. United had one good chance, after just a couple of minutes, and even that came after some terrible ball control from Diogo Dalot and a lucky bounce off Perrone, for whom Dalot’s inability to control a football had been not so much unpredictable as unimaginable. I’m not sure what Uefa classify as an “attack” but Como have had 16 of them, and United five.
 Share 1h ago 13.34 EDT Half time: Como 1-0 Manchester United
 45+2 mins: It never rains but it pours, etc.
 View image in fullscreen Manchester United manager Michael Carrick heads back to the dressing room to plug in his hairdryer. Photograph: Marco Luzzani/Getty Images Share Updated at  13.40 EDT 1h ago 13.33 EDT 45+1 mins: One minute of stoppage time stands between United and the hairdryer treatment (or whatever it is they get these days when they’ve been rubbish).
 Share 1h ago 13.32 EDT 45 mins: An actual shot for United! Matheus Cunha gets the ball on the left-hand corner of the area, back to goal, then spins and sends a curling effort onto the roof of the net.
 Share 1h ago 13.31 EDT 43 mins: More work for Lammens, this time to keep out Baturina’s 20-yarder. He can’t hold it, but Douvikas is offside again as he reaches the rebound. “It’s mindblowing,” writes Joshua Keeling, “that Diogo Dalot is a professional footballer.”
 Share 1h ago 13.29 EDT 41 mins: United are saved by the offside flag! Douvikas is played through again, Lammens comes out and the striker goes over his leg … but the flag is up!
 View image in fullscreen Como's Tasos Douvikas (left) hits the deck in the area but the offside flag comes to Manchester United’s rescue. Photograph: Piero Cruciatti/AFP/Getty Images Share Updated at  13.42 EDT 1h ago 13.26 EDT 39 mins: Real chance! Yan Couto, no pressure on him, plays a lovely pass over the United defence to Douvikas, who brings it under control before wildly mishitting his shot, which skews off his shin high and wide when really he should have scored.
